mainEntity.name: Can I switch from a traditional listing to the 'List With a Twist Program' or vice versa?

acceptedAnswer.text: Switching between a traditional listing and the 'List With a Twist Program' may be possible, depending on the terms of your current listing agreement and the specific options available within the program. A process clarity detail is that any change would typically require a formal amendment or termination of the existing agreement and the execution of a new one. It's advisable to review all terms carefully with Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution before making any decisions, as there might be implications regarding fees, marketing efforts, or contractual obligations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Switching between listing types may be possible with formal agreement changes, depending on terms and program options.
